objective.text: Compute a webhook signature over the exact raw body rather than a re-encoded parsed JSON object.

difficulty.rationale: Preserve the exact bytes authenticated by the provider’s signature scheme.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: The provider specifies HMAC-SHA256 over the exact HTTP body bytes with a shared secret. Its signature is compared using hash_equals.

stem: A valid webhook fails signature verification after the application decodes JSON and re-encodes it before calculating the HMAC. What should the calculation use?

options.text: Only the first business field because all fields came from one JSON document.
options.rationale: That changes the authenticated message and leaves other fields outside the specified signature.
options.misconception: That changes the authenticated message and leaves other fields outside the specified signature.

options.text: $request->getContent(), preserving the raw signed body bytes.
options.rationale: Whitespace, key ordering or escape representation can change during JSON re-encoding even when the data means the same thing. The HMAC contract authenticates bytes.

options.text: json_encode($request->all()) with the application’s default options.
options.rationale: Parsing and re-encoding may change the provider’s exact signed representation.
options.misconception: Parsing and re-encoding may change the provider’s exact signed representation.

options.text: A sorted JSON object to normalize both sides without changing the provider.
options.rationale: Canonicalization works only when both sides share that signing contract; it is not the stated raw-byte scheme.
options.misconception: Canonicalization works only when both sides share that signing contract; it is not the stated raw-byte scheme.
